description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseOnboardingService' that manages onboarding workflows for organizations, including creating onboarding records, handling team migrations, inviting members, and managing organization setup. It interacts with various repositories and services for organization, team, user, and email management.

classes.name: BaseOnboardingService
classes.description: An abstract class providing onboarding workflows for organizations, including creating onboarding records, handling team migrations, inviting members, and managing organization setup.

methods.name: createOnboardingIntent
methods.description: Abstract method to create an onboarding intent based on input.

methods.name: createOrganization
methods.description: Abstract method to create an organization with onboarding data and optional payment details.

methods.name: createOnboardingRecord
methods.description: Creates or updates an onboarding record, processing brand assets and managing existing onboarding data.

methods.name: ensureConflictingSlugTeamIsMigrated
methods.description: Ensures that any team with a conflicting slug owned by the user is migrated.

methods.name: buildTeamsAndInvites
methods.description: Prepares team and invited member data for onboarding.

methods.name: handleAdminHandoverIfNeeded
methods.description: Handles special flow when an admin is handing over organization ownership.

methods.name: isAdminCreatingForSelf
methods.description: Checks if an admin is creating an organization for themselves.

methods.name: processOnboardingBrandAssets
methods.description: Resizes and processes onboarding logo and banner images.

methods.name: uploadImageAsset
methods.description: Uploads a base64 image asset as a logo or banner.

methods.name: uploadOrganizationBrandAssets
methods.description: Uploads and updates organization logo and banner assets.

methods.name: createOrganizationWithExistingUserAsOwner
methods.description: Creates an organization with an existing user as owner, reusing existing org if available.

methods.name: createOrganizationWithNonExistentUserAsOwner
methods.description: Creates an organization with a new user as owner, sending verification and notification emails.

methods.name: createOrMoveTeamsToOrganization
methods.description: Creates new teams and moves existing teams into the organization.

methods.name: inviteMembers
methods.description: Invites members to the organization or specific teams.

methods.name: ensureStripeCustomerIdIsUpdated
methods.description: Updates the Stripe customer ID for a user.

methods.name: backwardCompatibilityForSubscriptionDetails
methods.description: Ensures legacy subscription details are updated in organization metadata.

methods.name: hasConflictingOrganization
methods.description: Checks if an organization with the same slug has a conflicting onboarding record.

methods.name: handleDomainSetup
methods.description: Sets up the domain for the organization if not already configured.
